name: ui-variants
title: UI Variants
description: The class recipes behind the contracted primitives (app button, badge, card, alert, input, label, skeleton, the marketing pill button), with no framework in them, so the .astro and .tsx builds of a contract emit identical classes.
author: Mzizi, operated by Nyuchi Africa (Pvt) Ltd — https://mzizi.dev
docs:
Use it for: Class recipes shared by the Astro and React builds.
Includes: Class recipes shared by the Astro and React builds.
Accessibility: Non-visual helper - no direct a11y requirements.
Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://api.mzizi.dev/v1/ui/ui-variants
